title: The Water Will Carry Us (bc30)
synopsis: A grieving veteran member of a local dragon boat training centre, shattered by his son’s disappearance in a sea accident, encounters the restless spirit of a young surfer lost to the waves. Lighting an eternal lantern by the shore, he tries to guide the soul home—while confronting the grief that has haunted him for a decade.

synopsis_lang.en: A grieving veteran member of a local dragon boat training centre, shattered by his son’s disappearance in a sea accident, encounters the restless spirit of a young surfer lost to the waves. Lighting an eternal lantern by the shore, he tries to guide the soul home—while confronting the grief that has haunted him for a decade.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 滑浪手遇溺失蹤多時，屍骨未歸。海灘盛傳鬧鬼，眾人避之則吉，唯有龍舟會船工風平，看見死者家屬在岸邊哭喊，只覺感同身受。十年前，風平的兒子在海難中為救人而失蹤。風平踏遍他鄉尋子，一無所獲,為抓住與兒子的連結，他回到跟兒子一同練習龍舟的海邊寄居。這次不期而遇的鬧鬼，猶如一記響徹十年的回聲。風平在龍舟會外點起長明燈，盼能助這亡魂找回歸來的路。這片海也牽動著身邊的人。當年海難倖存的兒子女友 Liz如今已另組家庭，並決定隨丈夫回流澳洲，眼見撇下風平一個，她滿懷愧疚。Liz 的女傭 Zen 因玩龍舟而跟風平生出似有還無的情愫,隨著僱主離港，Zen 也為該回到海的彼岸還是留下來而迷惘。正當各人內心湧動不息之際，一具屍體輕然泊岸。

cast: Emotion Cheung, Hedwig Tam, Adora F. Fouque, Lyman Heung
